title: probe: does a Codex-native sentinel seat get its verdict attested

evidence.risk: decides between a docs-only fix and a trust: question on an attest CLI (#962 anti-forgery stance) before anyone builds either

why: Cheapest way to settle #1078: if a Codex-native spawn_agent sentinel seat is attested by SubagentStop, the fix is docs only.
promise: A run, not a change. On a machine with the Codex CLI, the WUWEI plugin trusted in Codex and `wuwei init --codex` applied in this repository, start one Codex session whose brief has it spawn_agent with agent_type sentinel-quality on a small pushed branch, then read the ledger for an attest row naming that verdict file. An attest row means the Codex-native seat path works and gate-charters names it as the only Codex gate route (closing #1078 with the doors' existing "verdict ... not counted: not attested" gap). No row means a trust: question to the owner on a planner-side attest command that checks the Codex job's own session log. Touches no files. acceptance: given a Codex session in this repository with the WUWEI hooks trusted, when it spawns a sentinel-quality seat that writes a well-formed verdict and ends with its "Verdict file:" line, then the ledger holds an attest row with that path and gate quality, or the run evidence says it does not and what the SubagentStop payload carried
